reasoning_content:
Note: SMTP_HOST=mailcatcher will not resolve within the compose network unless a mailcatcher service exists. I don't intend to add one (SMTP can't truly be verified without an actual relay — it's an external service). In production, mail sending will fail, but the stack will start up. The guide requires an external SMTP relay, but it's not available in this sandbox. This is a known constraint, and the app functions for everything except actually sending mail.

Step 5: Build and start. Since this will take a long time (torch's pip install, npm build, 4.6GB model download), I'll start it as a background process and monitor the logs.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d --build > /tmp/compose_up.log 2>&1 &
echo "started build pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
